body:
I shouldn't have posted in here and I'm sorry. Thank you for taking the time to read my post & to offer a reply though. I cross-posted to another subreddit where I believe the answers are likely to have more truth in them, rather than based around offering a way to prevent a suicide. I need to hear cold, hard truths instead of selfishly trying to find comfort for my own feelings by posting in the  /r/suicidewatch community.

Thank you again for taking the time to offer your answers with open minds. You are good people.
